entries.text: 洛托洛托洛托……
entries.label: team_0020_system_01

entries.text: 天星隊的基地就在附近了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_02

entries.text: 既然[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳都來到這裡了，\n就代表[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳願意幫忙……對吧？[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_03

entries.text: 是的
entries.label: team_0020_select_01

entries.text: 無可奈何
entries.label: team_0020_select_02

entries.text: 謝謝。\n這麼一來，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳也是夥伴……[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_04

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是執行星塵大作戰的成員了！[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_05

entries.text: 我說，那個計畫……\n能不能讓我也湊一腳？[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_02

entries.text: 我是聶凱。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_03

entries.text: 你從什麼時候開始偷聽的？[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_07

entries.text: 喂喂，用不著那麼警戒我。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_04

entries.text: 我和這傢伙是一夥的。\n是吧？[VAR 0x0100(0000)]？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_05

entries.text: 是嗎……？
entries.label: team_0020_select_03

entries.text: 才不是！
entries.label: team_0020_select_04

entries.text: 喂喂！[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳這傢伙還是\n一樣那麼容易害臊啊！[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_06

entries.text: 對手是天星隊。\n這可不是在玩扮家家酒。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_08

entries.text: 我知道啊……\n我和天星隊也有不少恩怨的。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_07

entries.text: 雖然這麼說是在自賣自誇，\n但我辦事你不需要擔心。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_08

entries.text: …………\c\n現在人手不足，連喵喵的手都想借。\n歡迎你加入成為我們的夥伴。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_09

entries.text: 那就說定囉。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_09

entries.text: 話說你叫仙后對吧？\n你究竟是什麼來頭？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_10

entries.text: 我仙后是\n天星隊的前……\r\n你知道我是相關人員就夠了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_10

entries.text: ……這樣啊。\n那我就不細問了。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_11

entries.text: ……那麼，讓我馬上來\n說明一下星塵大作戰吧。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_11

entries.text: 具體上我們該做些什麼？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_12

entries.text: 簡單地說，\n就是要闖入天星隊的基地。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_12

entries.text: 打倒率領小隊的每個老大……\n讓老大通通下台！[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_13

entries.text: 下台……？\n意思是要讓老大引退嗎？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_13

entries.text: 沒錯……\n天星隊共有５個小隊，\r\n每個小隊都擁有各自的基地。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_14

entries.text: 這附近應該可以看到一個門。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_15

entries.text: ……看來是那個了。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_14

entries.text: 穿過門之後就是天星隊的基地。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_16

entries.text: 我們的目標――小隊的老大，\n應該就在基地的深處。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_17

entries.text: 天星隊有個隊規。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_18

entries.text: 只要有人上門挑釁，\n老大就只有迎戰這個選擇。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_19

entries.text: 同時……\n要是老大輸給了上門挑釁的人，\r\n就必須引退。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_20

entries.text: 剛剛我已經以[VAR 0x0100(0000)]的\n名義向各個基地宣戰了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_21

entries.text: 換句話說，\n我們已經向天星隊挑釁了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_22

entries.text: 只要打倒老大，\n讓老大引退……[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_16

entries.text: [EMPTY 66]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_23

entries.text: 相信失去老大的小隊，\n自然會群龍無首，潰不成軍。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_24

entries.text: [EMPTY 66]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_17

entries.text: 不過，同時也有個問題。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_25

entries.text: 基地內可以看到阻擋入侵者\n去路的寶可夢在四處徘徊。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_26

entries.text: 以一般訓練家的實力，\n很難抵達老大所在的地方。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_27

entries.text: [EMPTY 66]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_29

entries.text: [EMPTY 66]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_30

entries.text: 去打倒基地內的寶可夢，\n逼迫老大出來。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_31

entries.text: ……不過，首先得進入基地裡才行。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳去解決看門的人吧。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_32

entries.text: 那你要做什麼？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_18

entries.text: ……如同我剛所說的，\n我以前是天星隊的相關人員。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_33

entries.text: 我無法公開行動……\n讓我從遠處支援吧。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_34

entries.text: 有什麼我能做的事嗎？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_19

entries.text:
抱歉，
我還無法完全地信任你……\c
就拜託你監視基地周圍，
還有協助[VAR 0x0100(0000)]了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_35

entries.text: ……我倒是不討厭慎重的人啊。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_20

entries.text: 作戰有進展之後我會聯絡[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的。\n祝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳好運。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_36

entries.text: 校長……？
entries.label: team_0020_select_05

entries.text: 那個……
entries.label: team_0020_select_06

entries.text: 哎呀，關於我的真實身分，\n就拜託[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳把嘴巴拉上拉鍊了。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_22

entries.text: 我現在是聶凱……\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就當作是那麼一回事吧。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_23
